name: REFERRAL REPORT – FIXED
query:
SELECT
    report_data.invoice AS `Invoice`,
    report_data.invoice_date AS `Invoice Date`,
    report_data.branch AS `Branch`,
    report_data.customer AS `Customer`,
    report_data.client_name AS `Client Name`,
    report_data.booking_type AS `Booking Type`,

    report_data.payment_ids AS `Payment IDs`,
    report_data.payment_dates AS `Payment Dates`,
    report_data.mode_of_payment AS `Mode of Payment`,

    report_data.referring_employee AS `Referring Employee`,
    report_data.referring_practitioner_id AS `Referring Practitioner ID`,
    report_data.referring_employee_id AS `Referring Employee ID`,

    report_data.incentive_employee AS `Incentive Employee`,
    report_data.incentive_employee_id AS `Incentive Employee ID`,

    CASE
        WHEN report_data.has_referring_employee = 1
         AND report_data.has_incentive_employee = 1
            THEN 'Shared - Half Each'

        WHEN report_data.has_referring_employee = 1
            THEN 'Referring Employee Only'

        WHEN report_data.has_incentive_employee = 1
            THEN 'Incentive Employee Only'

        ELSE 'No Employee'
    END AS `Sharing Type`,

    CASE
        WHEN report_data.has_referring_employee = 1
         AND report_data.has_incentive_employee = 1
            THEN 2
        ELSE 1
    END AS `Employee Count`,

    ROUND(
        report_data.paid_amount,
        2
    ) AS `Paid Amount`,

    ROUND(
        report_data.paid_amount - report_data.amount_without_gst,
        2
    ) AS `GST Amount`,

    ROUND(
        report_data.amount_without_gst,
        2
    ) AS `Paid Amount Without GST`,

    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN report_data.has_referring_employee = 1
             AND report_data.has_incentive_employee = 1
                THEN report_data.amount_without_gst / 2

            WHEN report_data.has_referring_employee = 1
                THEN report_data.amount_without_gst

            ELSE 0
        END,
        2
    ) AS `Referring Employee Share`,

    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN report_data.has_referring_employee = 1
             AND report_data.has_incentive_employee = 1
                THEN report_data.amount_without_gst / 2

            WHEN report_data.has_incentive_employee = 1
                THEN report_data.amount_without_gst

            ELSE 0
        END,
        2
    ) AS `Incentive Employee Share`,

    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN report_data.has_referring_employee = 1
              OR report_data.has_incentive_employee = 1
                THEN report_data.amount_without_gst
            ELSE 0
        END,
        2
    ) AS `Total Distributed Amount`,

    ROUND(
        report_data.grand_total,
        2
    ) AS `Grand Total`,

    ROUND(
        report_data.outstanding_amount,
        2
    ) AS `Outstanding Amount`

FROM
(
    SELECT
        si.name AS invoice,
        si.posting_date AS invoice_date,
        si.branch AS branch,
        si.customer AS customer,
        si.patient_name AS client_name,
        tp.media AS booking_type,

        payments.payment_ids AS payment_ids,
        payments.payment_dates AS payment_dates,
        payments.mode_of_payment AS mode_of_payment,
        payments.paid_amount AS paid_amount,

        payments.paid_amount / 1.05 AS amount_without_gst,

        si.custom_referring_name AS referring_employee,
        si.ref_practitioner AS referring_practitioner_id,
        hp.employee AS referring_employee_id,

        si.custom_incentive_employee_name AS incentive_employee,
        inc_emp.employee_id AS incentive_employee_id,

        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(si.custom_referring_name, '') <> ''
                THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS has_referring_employee,

        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(si.custom_incentive_employee_name, '') <> ''
                THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS has_incentive_employee,

        si.grand_total AS grand_total,
        si.outstanding_amount AS outstanding_amount

    FROM `tabSales Invoice` si

    INNER JOIN `tabTherapy Plan` tp
        ON tp.name = si.therapy_plan_reference_id

    INNER JOIN
    (
        SELECT
            per.reference_name AS sales_invoice,

            GROUP_CONCAT(
                DISTINCT pe.name
                ORDER BY pe.posting_date, pe.name
                SEPARATOR ', '
            ) AS payment_ids,

            GROUP_CONCAT(
                DISTINCT pe.posting_date
                ORDER BY pe.posting_date
                SEPARATOR ', '
            ) AS payment_dates,

            GROUP_CONCAT(
                DISTINCT pe.mode_of_payment
                ORDER BY pe.mode_of_payment
                SEPARATOR ', '
            ) AS mode_of_payment,

            SUM(per.allocated_amount) AS paid_amount

        FROM `tabPayment Entry Reference` per

        INNER JOIN `tabPayment Entry` pe
            ON pe.name = per.parent
            AND pe.docstatus = 1

        WHERE
            per.reference_doctype = 'Sales Invoice'
            AND pe.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s

        GROUP BY
            per.reference_name

        HAVING
            SUM(per.allocated_amount) > 0

    ) payments
        ON payments.sales_invoice = si.name

    LEFT JOIN `tabHealthcare Practitioner` hp
        ON hp.name = si.ref_practitioner

    LEFT JOIN
    (
        SELECT
            employee_name,
            MIN(name) AS employee_id
        FROM `tabEmployee`
        WHERE status = 'Active'
        GROUP BY employee_name
    ) inc_emp
        ON inc_emp.employee_name =
           si.custom_incentive_employee_name

    WHERE
        si.docstatus = 1
        
        AND
        (
            COALESCE(si.custom_referring_name, '') <> ''
            OR
            COALESCE(si.custom_incentive_employee_name, '') <> ''
        )

) report_data

ORDER BY
    report_data.invoice_date,
    report_data.invoice
